description: Track a new question for a domain, e.g. "best invoicing software for freelancers". Scheduled checks then ask the plan's AI engines whether they cite the brand. Fails at the plan's question limit. Free: it uses no credits.

domain_id.description: The tracked domain's id, from list_domains.

locale.description: Market locale such as en-US or de-DE. Omit for the default market.

question.description: The question, as a user would ask an AI engine.

name: add_question
title: Add a question
